name: War at Sea
label: Quest
description: War at Sea: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You seek to befriend the goblins of Tanaris once again, friend? We're in need of materials for sails and guns to fight off our old enemies, the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Bring me mageweave and strong flux and we'll be on our way to pardoning your trespasses.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Keep it coming, friend. Us goblins don't forget that easily!
